_comment: Provenance of the WASM extension bundles the web apps ship. duckdb-wasm's core is built from one DuckDB release (duckdb_abi); the side modules must be built for the same release or LOAD fails. `bundles` names the source copy of each extension and where scripts/build_wasm_extensions.py installs it; every other copy in the tree must be byte-identical to the source copy (T7, fhir4ds/operations/tests/wasm_parity/shipped_bundles.py). A bundle's `source` stays null until scripts/build_wasm_extensions.py rebuilds it: the bundles shipped today carry only the ABI stamp.
